text:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp is getting a ton of 429s during initial sync for large orgs. Paging + prefetch seems to cause bursts. Anyone seen this pattern?

devon: Yep, saw this with prefetch=3 and concurrency 6 on js-sdk v1.4.2. Prefetch + windowing + retries created a loop.

jules: Are those global quota hits or per-route concurrency? Do the X-RateLimit-* headers show anything?

maria: Headers: X-RateLimit-Limit=500/min, Remaining tanks fast then 429 with Retry-After sometimes 1 or 0.5. We're prefetching next 3 pages on scroll and parallelism=6.

devon: Classic cold-start thundering herd. SDK prefetch needs to honor client-side token bucket / backpressure. Sampleapp default config was aggressive.

jules: SDK parity note — python sdk has jittered exponential backoff for 429s. js sdk only did linear retries in the last release. We should align behaviors.

sdk-bot: deploy-bot: rolled out js-sdk v1.5.0-beta to canary channels with exponential-backoff option.

maria: Short-term mitigation: reduce prefetch to 1 and add smoothing that spaces page fetches by ~rand(0..200)ms. Cuts burst by ~60% in our local runs.

devon: We added a tiny leaky-bucket wrapper in sampleapp: 
```js
const limiter = createLimiter({rate: 10, per: 1000});
await limiter.schedule(() => fetchPage(cursor));
```
That plus commit-after-process prevented duplicate refetches.

jules: Also recommend committing cursors only after page is fully processed and adding ETag/If-None-Match where applicable to avoid wasted work.

maria: Can we add a sampleapp patch + onboarding doc note? Also would like a telemetry event `prefetch_attempt` with org_size bucket so we can profile.

devon: I'll open a PR to change sampleapp defaults and include limiter util. @jules can you create an issue to align retry parity and add tests?

jules: On it — will include a simulated-burst test (200 simulated cursors) asserting >=95% success without 429s when smoothing enabled. :white_check_mark: 

opsbot: incident-bot: Registered — if sustained 429s >=5% of requests for a tenant, console will auto-suggest Dedicated / burst config to the customer.

maria: Great. Next steps: PRs for sampleapp + js-sdk canary, doc note in onboarding guide, telemetry event. Leaving a short how-to in the sampleapp README. :thumbsup:
